# Isolated upstream reference files

Selected files are byte-for-byte copies from the supplied h3-film-main archive. SOURCE_MANIFEST.json records original paths and SHA-256 hashes. No upstream commit was verified. They are included as private reference material at the owner's request, not as a vendored dependency. Our Python runner does not import or execute them.

The source identifies https://github.com/li-yunshen-alec/h3-film. No root source-code license was found in the supplied archive. A relayed permission to copy does not create a public redistribution license. Keep this export private until rights are cleared. Preserve the source attribution. Upstream comments and names are unchanged by design.

These files are NOT a runnable copy of the upstream system. Their dependencies, other source files, models, fonts, GPU environment and account configuration are not bundled. They contain provider calls and process execution. Do not run them merely because this export's local tests pass.

The fresh audio-first implementation is under magicdrama/audiofirst. It shares design ideas, not these modules' runtime. Timed frame pinning remains unavailable in the documented Magic Hour adapter. A shot's pin requirement fails closed instead of being silently dropped.
